policies.n: Belgian ordinary-passport visitors require a visa. Apply in the country of residence, or a neighbouring country where no DRC mission is present in the residence country. Belgian residents of Belgium are directed to Brussels or Antwerp. The permitted stay and nationality-specific electronic issuance route are not established; this visa requirement does not mean eVisa is unavailable.

Japanese ordinary-passport tourists require a visa. Tokyo describes original-passport consular processing, including a passport valid over six months, itinerary, accommodation and yellow-fever certificate. Six months is visa validity, not a universal stay. The permitted stay and nationality-specific electronic issuance route are not established; this visa requirement does not mean eVisa is unavailable.
Dutch ordinary-passport visitors require a visa. The permitted stay and nationality-specific electronic issuance route are not established; this visa requirement does not mean eVisa is unavailable.

Spanish visitors require a visa obtained in Spain or their country of residence. The DRC embassy in Brazzaville cannot issue visas to foreigners not resident in the Republic of Congo. The permitted stay and nationality-specific electronic issuance route are not established; this visa requirement does not mean eVisa is unavailable.

Russian ordinary passports require a visa. The March 2025 diplomatic/service waiver does not cover ordinary tourists. The permitted stay and nationality-specific electronic issuance route are not established; this visa requirement does not mean eVisa is unavailable.

Australian DFAT requires a visa before travel and advises that Australian travellers cannot obtain one on arrival. Nationality-specific electronic eligibility and the permitted stay are not established here; eVisa unavailability is not inferred.

Dutch ordinary-passport visitors require a visa; Dutch guidance directs applicants to the Iranian embassy in The Hague. Taiwan BOCA expressly reports that all foreign visa applicants must use a legally registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary. This does not apply a visa duty to independently exempt passports. No residence, preapproval, arrival eligibility or qualifying itinerary is assumed. Issuance method and permitted stay remain uncertain.

Belgian visitors require a visa. Belgian guidance also mentions a tourist airport-issuance procedure at Tehran Imam Khomeini, but its complete current eligibility/preapproval conditions are not established, so no arrival entitlement is asserted. Taiwan BOCA expressly reports that all foreign visa applicants must use a legally registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary. This does not apply a visa duty to independently exempt passports. No residence, preapproval, arrival eligibility or qualifying itinerary is assumed. Stay and final issuance method remain uncertain.

Danish ordinary-passport visitors require a visa and online application. MFA guidance reports a maximum stay of 90 days, with issuance online, at a mission or at an airport depending on the case; this does not establish interchangeable methods or an automatic 90-day grant. Taiwan BOCA expressly reports that all foreign visa applicants must use a legally registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary. This does not apply a visa duty to independently exempt passports. No residence, preapproval, arrival eligibility or qualifying itinerary is assumed. Final method and granted duration must be confirmed.

Slovenian MFA explicitly requires a visa and identifies the Iranian electronic visa. It says airport issuance is suspended until further notice; no airport alternative is assigned. Taiwan BOCA expressly reports that all foreign visa applicants must use a legally registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary. This does not apply a visa duty to independently exempt passports. No residence, preapproval, arrival eligibility or qualifying itinerary is assumed. No source-established fixed stay is assigned.

Estonian ordinary-passport visitors require a visa. Taiwan BOCA expressly reports that all foreign visa applicants must use a legally registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary. This does not apply a visa duty to independently exempt passports. No residence, preapproval, arrival eligibility or qualifying itinerary is assumed. The electronic/consular/airport issuance branch and permitted stay remain uncertain.

Macao SAR passport, not the Macao travel permit: DSI expressly reports visa-free entry for up to 21 days. Mainland Chinese and Hong Kong documents are not inferred from this record. The foreign visa-applicant agency rule is not assumed to require visas for already exempt visitors.

Russian ordinary-passport visitors require a visa unless they qualify for the bilateral organised-tourist-group exemption. The Russian MFA reports that exemption as up to 15 days, at most 90 in 180; an agency-arranged itinerary alone is not proof of the treaty group qualification. Group approval/list and other implementing requirements remain to be established for a personal waiver decision. Taiwan BOCA expressly reports that all foreign visa applicants must use a legally registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary. This does not apply a visa duty to independently exempt passports. No residence, preapproval, arrival eligibility or qualifying itinerary is assumed. The visa branch has no verified fixed stay or issuance method.
policies.label: Visa required; qualifying tour-group exception

policies.n: Ordinary national passport: visa required under the Immigration (Passports) Order default, read with the current MFA and embassy exemption schedules. Diplomatic/service-only waivers do not extend to this passport. A pre-approved arrival process may be available depending on residence and ability to apply at a Guyana mission; no such condition is assumed. Online application, prior approval and border issuance are sequential, not interchangeable visa methods. The nationality-specific issuance channel and granted stay remain uncertain; eVisa unavailability is not inferred.

Visa required for an ordinary passport without qualifying foreign documentation. Current mission schedules provide a 90-day exemption for holders of a valid US, Canadian or Schengen visa or a US permanent resident card; no such document is assumed. The non-exempt visa branch has no verified fixed stay or unconditional electronic/arrival entitlement.
policies.label: Visa required; foreign-document exemption

policies.n: Spanish ordinary-passport exemption is established by the currently published statutory Schedule and corroborated by two embassy schedules. The central MFA table mentions diplomatic passports but supplies no express revocation of the statutory ordinary exemption. No fixed ordinary visitor stay is established across these sources; confirm the granted period rather than assuming 90 days.

Turkish ordinary-passport visitors require a visa. The separate diplomatic/service/special passport waiver does not apply to ordinary passports. Nationality-specific electronic/arrival eligibility and the permitted stay remain uncertain.

Serbian ordinary-passport holders require a visa, expressly confirmed in the outbound entry section of Serbia MFA advice. The nearby table labelled entry into Serbia is not inverted. Nationality-specific electronic/arrival eligibility and stay remain uncertain.

Macao SAR ordinary passport requires a visa. DSI explicitly identifies a 30-day tourist arrival visa and electronic processing, with invitation, host/hotel contacts, two photographs and funds. Guyana limits its pre-approved arrival procedure by mission access/residence: obtain and print approval before travel where eligible; it is not a walk-up visa or an independent electronic alternative. No residence or approval is assumed. Consular eligibility and stay outside that branch are not established.
policies.label: Visa required; pre-approved arrival branch

policies.n: Ordinary passports are subject to the current Visa Regime Decree Article 4 default; these nationalities are not in its ordinary-passport exemptions. No diplomatic/service treaty benefit is assumed. Article 7 separately permits up to 30 days with a valid Schengen, Australian, Japanese, Canadian, New Zealand, Irish, US or UK visa or residence permit, or an APEC business travel card, never beyond that document’s expiry. No qualifying foreign document is assumed. The ordinary visa branch’s granted stay and electronic availability remain uncertain.
policies.label: Visa required; foreign-document exception

policies.n: Somali nationals are subject to the EU visa requirement. The Commission’s 2 October 2026 recognition matrix marks the ordinary Somali passport as not recognised by Benelux, including Luxembourg. This is a visa/document-authorisation requirement only: it does not establish a routinely issuable tourist visa, acceptance of the ordinary passport, a substitute-document approval, or lawful Schengen transit. Any exceptional territorial/separate-sheet permission and itinerary require an individual authority decision; the practical tourist route and stay remain unresolved.
policies.label: Visa required; passport not recognised
